verdict.rationale: Kick's Rules feature lets users define custom logic that automatically triggers actions (overriding AI categorization) whenever a matching transaction event (sync) occurs, confirmed consistently across multiple docs pages. This is a genuine event-triggered automation capability, though scoped specifically to transaction categorization/handling rather than a general-purpose rules engine covering arbitrary events and actions. Missing for 10: evidence of rules triggering on non-transaction events, complex multi-condition/multi-action workflows, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
